topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides introductory framing and context for the lecture on complement.

topics.label: Fundamentals and central mechanics of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the overarching organisation, nomenclature conventions, and the central role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the three distinct recognition pathways that initiate complement and converge on C3 convertase formation.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three primary downstream actions executed by complement to eliminate pathogens and promote inflammation.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activity
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that prevent complement from damaging host tissues.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how genetic and acquired deficiencies across different complement components produce specific clinical disease presentations.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the molecular strategies evolved by pathogens to circumvent complement-mediated immunity.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks and a preview of the upcoming topic.
